title: Classical planning — coverage
description: Eighteen instances spanning trivial to genuinely hard for a pure-Python planner, run over six jupyddl configurations with a 20-second per-instance budget. Read the cactus plot rather than the mean runtime: the configurations differ in how many instances they finish at all, not in how fast they finish the easy ones.
machine: 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-11850H @ 2.50GHz (16 logical CPUs), Linux 6.8.0-136-generic (x86_64), Python 3.10.12, harness 0.1.0@81d9ca15e4c6. Installed: jupyddl 2.3.0, matplotlib 3.10.9, numpy 2.2.6, openplan-bench 0.1.0, pymapf 0.8.0.
